scripts.start: concurrently -n web,queue,ngrok,webhook -c blue,green,yellow,magenta --restart-tries -1 --restart-after 5000 "php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000" "php artisan queue:work --queue=assistant,voice,media,default --sleep=2 --timeout=300 --max-time=3600" "ngrok http 8000" "php artisan telegram:sync-ngrok --watch"
